About

We don't run ads. We build revenue systems.

Why Demoski exists

Most businesses do not have a traffic problem. They have a conversion problem, and they are paying an agency to ignore it.

We work with e-commerce brands, small and medium businesses and founders who are done experimenting and want a system that brings in consistent, predictable revenue. Every engagement starts with strategy, not ad spend.

From the first ad creative to the landing page, the offer, the funnel and the follow-up, we own the whole chain. A great ad sending traffic to a weak page is a fast way to burn budget.

If you want pretty reports, we are not the right fit. If you want leads, sales and a return you can measure, talk to us.

How we work

Six rules we hold ourselves to.

Data before decisions

Targeting, creative and budget choices come from pixel data and audience insight.

Full-funnel ownership

Ads, pages, copy and follow-up are aligned to one outcome: your revenue.

Conversion first

Traffic that does not convert is noise. We work on every step between click and sale.

Built to scale

A campaign that works at ₦20,000 a month should still work at ₦200,000.

You see everything

Every number, every report and the reason behind each decision. No hidden fees.

Speed

We reply within one hour in business hours and we keep to deadlines.
